name: arxivlab
description: arXivLab desktop research workstation with Zotero sync, custom DNS, and MCP server
author: arXivLab

scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run build:server && npx --yes electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:server && npx --yes electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build && npm run build:server && npx --yes electron-builder --linux AppImage --win nsis portable --publish never
